title: Fall Damage Preview
description: See how much fall damage you would take before falling!
body:
# Fall Damage Preview
This **clientside** mod adds a small display over your hotbar, when you **look down** and **press tab**, to tell you how much **damage** you would take if you **fall** down to where you're **looking** at. The mod calculates the damage taken, consideres armor, enchantments potion effects and the block you're landing on. If you want to see the **raw damage** that you would take without armor you can **press shift** by default to display the **raw damage**. The Colors of the Display and numbers and many other settings are **configurable**. The mod requires [YetAnotherConfigLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl).
